'''R2-F2''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]] that served as part of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. It flew with [[rebel pilot]] [[Biggs Darklighter]], and the pair were stationed at the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]'s [[Great Temple]].

In the [[Battle of Yavin]], Red [[Squadron]] were deployed to try and destroy the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] and flew in a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]. The Alliance's [[X-wing starfighter]]s were at first used to draw away fire from the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] by engaging enemy [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s or [[turret]]s. After most of the [[bomber]]s were destroyed, Darklighter and R2-F2 were part of an attempted attack run on the Death Star's vulnerable [[thermal exhaust port]]; however, they were both [[Death|killed]] during the run by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].

==Biography==
R2-F2<ref name="Hasbro" /> was the designation of an [[R2-series astromech droid]]<ref name="BYO R2" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="Manufacturer" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire]], it served in the Alliance's [[Massassi Group]], which was based out of their headquarters in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. The [[astromech droid]] flew with the [[Rebel pilot]] [[Biggs Darklighter]] as [[Red Three]] in the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps]]' [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]].<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:R2-F2_White.png|thumb|left|250px|R2-F2 flew with Biggs Darklighter in the Battle of Yavin.]]
When the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] arrived in the [[Yavin system]],<ref name="ANH" /> R2-F2 and Darklighter completed their pre-flight checks together<ref name="Desert Son">{{StoryCite|story=Desert Son|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> then launched with the rest of Red [[Squadron]] in order to try and destroy the [[battle station]] before it could obliterate Yavin 4. The Red Squadron [[starfighter]]s were tasked with drawing fire away from the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]], who made an attack run on the Death Star's one weakness: its [[thermal exhaust port]]<ref name="ANH" />

Gold Squadron were mostly destroyed during their failed attack run, leaving Red Squadron to attempt runs on the port instead. Darklighter and R2-F2 flew with [[pilot]]s [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Wedge Antilles]] down the Death Star's [[meridian trench]] toward the port, but before they could reach it, Darklighter and R2-F2 were [[Death|killed]] when the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] shot down their [[X-wing starfighter]]. The Death Star was ultimately destroyed when Skywalker managed to launch a [[proton torpedo]] down the exhaust port.<ref name="ANH" />

==Characteristics==
R2-F2 had [[Color|black]] and gray paneling and a black [[sensor]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> Like all R2 units, it stood 0.96 [[meter]]s (3[[Foot|ft]] 2in) tall.<ref name="AEYNTK:UE" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-F2 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> In the current [[canon]], the droid was first identified on an action figure set from the ''[[Star Wars: The Black Series]]'' released in [[2018]] by [[Hasbro]]<ref name="Hasbro" />

The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[2012]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game Core Set|Core Set]] of the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]''.<ref name="FFG">{{FFGXW|set=Core Set|cardname=R2-F2}}</ref> Prior to this though, the astromech droid [[R2-Q2]] had been described in several Legends sources as being the droid used by Darklighter at Yavin.<ref name="ActionFigureArchive">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref><ref name="HasbroAstromechs">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=Astromech Droid Pack (Series 1)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TSCastroS1.asp}}</ref> R2-Q2 is in fact a separate droid that appears in the opening sequence of ''A New Hope'', albeit with an incredibly similar color scheme to R2-F2.<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/1171203436576010240|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=R2-F2 is Biggs'. R2-Q2 is the Imperial droid on the Tantive IV. They look the same, so it's understandable why it may have gotten mixed up. There's a third droid with the same markings at the Resistance base on D'Qar.|archivefile=File:Leland Chee R2-F2.png}}</ref> This mistake was repeated in the [[2018]] "X-Wing Starfighter" [[LEGO]] set, in which R2-Q2 was included with Darklighter instead of R2-F2.<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|num=75218|name=X-Wing Starfighter}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2 79|seventy-ninth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2]]'' published by [[De Agostini]] of same year too, erroneously proclaimed that Darklighter's R2-series astromech at the Battle of Yavin was R2-Q2.<ref name="BYO R2" />
